AGENDA
  AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Welcome to the Glendale Audit Committee Meeting. If you have any agenda related questions or requests for assistance,
call the Finance Department at (818) 548-2085 during business hours. Audit Committee Meetings are archived and
available for viewing on the City’s website at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes. Audit Reports are
available for viewing on the following link: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/innovation-performance-
and-audit/audit-reports.

PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE HEARING ROOM.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation,
and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At
least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All
documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
are public records, will be available for review in the City Clerk’s Office at 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA
91206.

Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish to utilize the service
as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City Clerk’s office at 818-548-2090, at least 24 hours
prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.

  October 28, 2019 at 8:00 AM

 1. ROLL CALL

 2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The agenda for the October 28, 2019 Audit Committee Meeting was posted on Thursday,
  October 24, 2019 on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

 3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision. The
  Audit Committee Chair may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.

 4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  a. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on July 22, 2019

 5. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Discussion re: potential modification to the Audit Committee regular meeting
  schedule.
  1. Resolution modifying the Audit Committee regular meeting schedule.

 6. REPORTS – INFORMATION
  a. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 9/30/2019 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager
 7. COMMITTEE /STAFF COMMENTS

8. NEW BUSINESS

9. ADJOURNMENT

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  October 28, 2019

1.  ROLL CALL: 8:00 a.m.

  Present:  Zareh Amirian, Ed Khashadourian, Thomas O’Shaughnessy,
  Alex Parajon and Vahik Satoorian

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:

  A.  Report of Recording Secretary re: Posting of Agenda

  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of October 28, 2019 was posted on
  Thursday, October 24, 2019 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A.  Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on Monday,
  July 22, 2019

  Moved: Thom O’Shaughnessy  Second: Alex Parajon

  Vote as follows:
  Ayes:  Amirian, Khashadourian, O’Shaughnessy, Parajon
  Noes:
  Abstain:  Satoorian
  Absent:

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  A.  Discussion re: Potential Modification to the Audit Committee Regular Meeting
  Schedule

  At the request of Chair Amirian, a report was prepared by Internal Audit staff to consider
  alternative meeting dates and times for future Audit Committee meetings. Ms. Natalie Minami-
  Valdivia, Sr. Internal Auditor presented a report on alternative meeting times for consideration
  by the Audit Committee. After discussion, the Audit Committee decided to change the
  meeting date to the last Thursday of the first month of each quarter at 2:00 p.m. to be held in
  the Municipal Services Building Room 105; this action was taken by formal adoption of
  Resolution No. 4.
 Audit Committee Minutes
October 28, 2019

  Due to existing conflicts with schedules, the January 2020 meeting will take place on January
  27, 2020 at 8:00 a.m. The new schedule will take effect beginning with the April 2020 meeting
  (scheduled for 4/25/2020).

  Moved: Thom O’Shaughnessy  Second: Vahik Satoorian

  Vote as follows:
  Ayes:  Amirian, Khashadourian, O’Shaughnessy, Satoorian
  Noes:  Parajon
  Abstain:
  Absent:

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  A.  Internal Audit Activity Report as of September 30, 2019 – Jessie Zhang,
  Internal Audit Manager

  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Sr. Internal Auditor updated the Audit Committee on the Internal
  Audit activity for quarter ended September 30, 2019 where two project were completed:

  1) Mr. Sameel Salim, Sr. Internal Auditor presented the Cooperative Purchasing Agreements
  Audit. Mr. Afshin Bokaei, Purchasing Administrator was present and answered questions
  from the Committee.

  2) Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Sr. Internal Auditor presented the Multi-Project Affordable
  Housing Lottery Audit. Mr. Philip Lanzafame, Director of Community Development and
  Mr. Mike Fortney, Principal Housing Project Manager were present and answered
  questions from the Committee.

  As of September 30, 2019, there were three projects in progress, and three outstanding audit
  issues based on the criteria set by the Audit Committee in Resolution #2. The outstanding
  issues that have not been implemented within two years of the report date are: Homeless
  Programs Operations Audit, Refuse Collections Revenue Audit and GPD Property Room
  Audit.

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  Chair Amirian thanked various department staff for attending this meeting and
  answering questions on the audits presented.

8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian  Second: Alex Parajon

  Adjournment at 9:40 a.m.
